writeup: Woot has an open-box warehouse Callaway Reva Rise ladies left-hand 6-hybrid with the LinQ 40 gram ladies-flex shaft and Ai10x face for $99.99. Callaway's own site still sells this women's REVA Rise Hybrid at $269.99, and that same $269.99 price is live at Golf Galaxy, Dick's Sporting Goods, PGA TOUR Superstore, Golf Discount, Scheels, 2nd Swing, and ParWest Golf, all in stock for the left-hand 6H at 30 degrees. That's about $170 and 62 percent below the current street price. Only one is left, with a limit of 3 per customer.
amazon_match_notes: Verifier marked amazon_asin_verified B0DHWHDD99 as an exact match for the Callaway Golf Reva Rise Hybrid, Left Hand, Ladies Flex, 6 Hybrid, LinQ 40 Gram. Woot condition field was null; verifier treated it as open-box warehouse and applied the 55 percent bar.
